reconciliation.summary: A bounded real Linux-provider churn test now explicitly verifies cleanup-before-eviction. The retained MNCS runtime sequentially starts and reaps 129 /usr/bin/true transient user services; each must report cleanup_complete=true, tree_empty=true, and launcher_reaped before insertion can evict a terminal entry. The registry remains at 128, the expired opaque handle returns Unknown, retained handles still show cleanup proof, and active_count stays zero. A second test fills all 16 active slots with bounded /usr/bin/sleep jobs, rejects job 17, then cancels/reaps all 16. Four process_runtime tests passed in 6.65 seconds. Evidence is recorded from the Forge resident-safety pressure and cites the language provider test without broadening affectedRepositories.

pressures.title: Resident verification lacks proven host-resource self-protection

No file metadata (size/mtime/mode)
